issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, allowing slashes or '..' to route requests to unintended endpoints.
Transport errors and timeouts are neither retried nor wrapped, so callers receive raw httpx exceptions instead of client-level errors.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date values.
max_attempts accepts zero or negative values, causing no request to be made and a misleading error.
Paginated response shapes are not validated, causing silent drops for non-mapping items or raw KeyError exceptions for malformed objects.
batch_create materializes the entire iterable before chunking, which can exhaust memory or hang for large or infinite iterables.
Model parsers use direct indexing and coercion, exposing raw KeyError, TypeError, and ValueError instead of contextual parse errors.
Literal-typed fields are not validated at runtime, so invalid project statuses, task states, batch statuses, and review verdicts are accepted.
Frozen dataclasses expose mutable dict fields, so supposedly immutable model instances can still be mutated after construction.
The package advertises typed models but does not include a py.typed marker, so downstream type checkers may not treat it as a typed package.
Tests omit path escaping, malformed response validation, network failure handling, HTTP-date Retry-After, and runtime enum validation cases.
